perplexity.description:
Now That's What I Call An Era: The Albums 1980 > 1984 (Essential Tracks From Iconic Albums)" is a compilation album released in 2025 by Sony Music and EMI. It focuses on album tracks and deep cuts from the early 1980s, specifically between 1980 and 1984, rather than hit singles. The collection spans genres such as electronic, jazz, and rock, featuring influential artists like New Order, Simple Minds, Talk Talk, and David Sylvian. The deluxe 4CD edition includes a 28-page booklet with detailed track-by-track notes, while the 3LP vinyl version is pressed on colored vinyl, emphasizing the era's diverse musical styles and underground album gems.

This release is part of the "Now That's What I Call An Era" series, which aims to highlight significant but less commercially prominent tracks from key periods in music history. Unlike typical greatest hits compilations, this album offers a curated exploration of the early 80s album scene, showcasing the depth and innovation of the period’s electronic, jazz, and rock music. The album has been well received for its thoughtful curation and presentation, appealing to collectors and fans interested in the broader musical landscape of the early 1980s.
